result.summary: The page layout is generally intact (scrollable rows and cut-off cards excluded), but there is a notable contrast problem: white text on the pale green promo banner is hard to read, and some food card thumbnails appear blurry/low resolution.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you', 'Use code TALLINN3...', 'Order now' outline) is white/light on a pale mint-green background, giving very low contrast and poor readability, especially in bright environments and for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the light mint background, or darken the banner background so white text has sufficient contrast.

issues.description: Several food thumbnails (e.g., 'Smash Bros Burgers', 'Trattoria Piccola', 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar') appear blurry or overly soft, suggesting low-resolution or poorly scaled images.
issues.suggestion: Replace with higher-resolution or sharper imagery; if illustrations are intentional, increase their clarity and resolution.

issues.description: The delivery fee captions ('€0.90 delivery', '€2.40 delivery', '€1.90 delivery') are rendered in very light gray, which is low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the delivery fee text slightly or increase its weight to meet contrast guidelines.
